name: baseline.changes
title: Show changes since baseline
summary: What changed since a baseline, the newest one by default, and which hints are open, with the next steps: the numbers of baseline.get and the hints of hint.list in one output (SR-241).
details: Without a baseline it takes the one with the latest date and time, at the same time the last by file name, skipping a file that is no valid baseline (named under problems, as baseline.list names it). A given baseline is found as baseline.get finds it, and an unknown or ambiguous one is refused the same way. The next steps are Confirm hints when a hint can be confirmed, Compare baseline when an element is marked changed, and Prepare baseline; a step whose write command is refused while the workspace is read-only is left out (SR-226). After them List elements for each of changed, superseded, added and removed greater than 0, in this order: the elements this command counts for that number, the baseline by its name (by its file name when another baseline has the same name), on a page that holds them all, up to the largest page. Only reads.

baseline.description: Name of a baseline, or its file name (with or without .yaml); without it the newest baseline (SR-241 AK1).

limit.description: Hints of the page, as hint.list; hintTotal and hintKinds count all.

offset.description: Hints skipped before the page, in the order of `hints`.

output.description: An unknown or ambiguous baseline is input.invalid with details.reason unknown-baseline or ambiguous-baseline, as for baseline.get.

baseline.description: The baseline compared with and its elements per state, as baseline.get gives them; left out when the workspace has no baseline.

hints.title: Hints
hints.description: The open hints of the whole workspace, as hint.list gives them without a filter, whatever the baseline selects: one page of `limit` hints from `offset`.

hintKinds.title: Hints per kind
hintKinds.description: The number of open hints per kind, as `kinds` of hint.list without a filter (SR-026); empty without an open hint.

hintTotal.title: Open hints
hintTotal.description: All open hints, as `total` of hint.list without a filter.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The problems baseline.get gives for the baseline, and those baseline.list gives for the files that are no valid baseline.

next.title: Next steps
next.description: Confirm hints, Compare baseline, Prepare baseline and List elements, as the details say (SR-241 AK3, AK4, AK8).

names.title: Named elements
names.description: The variant of the baseline's view, as baseline.get names it, then the variants the `view` of an outdated evidence hint names, as hint.list names them (#2527); each once. Left out when it names none.
